|{1:* }{2:TODO}{1: }{3:[#A]}{1: Level one }{4::work:}|
|Body text of level one.|
|{5:** }{2:NEXT}{5: }{6:[#B]}{5: Level two }{4::home:errand:}|
|{7:*** }{8:DONE}{7: }{9:[#C]}{7: Level three}|
|{10:**** Level four with }{3:[#A]}{10: priority }{4::deep:}|
|{11:***** }{2:TODO}{11: Level five}|
|{1:* }{12:COMMENT}{1: A commented headline}|

{1} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title [bold]
{2} OrgTodo -> @comment.error
{3} OrgPriorityA -> DiagnosticError
{4} OrgTags -> @property
{5} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant
{6} OrgPriorityB -> DiagnosticWarn
{7} OrgHeadlineDone -> Comment
{8} OrgDone -> @comment.note
{9} OrgPriorityC -> DiagnosticInfo
{10} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement [bold]
{11} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc
{12} OrgHeadlineComment -> Comment
